title: fix(app-shell): an areas-only app lands on its first area entry; a url/action-only app says it opens from its menu
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb6YPmefvezx1CHWqAYCx6ZW)_
Fixes #29771

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：控制台打开一个应用的根地址时，落地页不再只看顶层导航：先看顶层导航，再按顺序看每个分区（areas）的导航，在全部这些导航里先找对象、页面、仪表盘、报表或组件条目，找不到再找第一个文档条目。若成员能看到的条目全是外部链接或动作，根页面显示一个空状态，说明“这个应用从菜单使用”，不再是一片空白。设计器预览里的“首页”提示同步这条规则。
- **为什么改**：条目只放在分区里的应用、以及菜单只有链接或动作的应用，打开后主区域一片空白，没有跳转也没有任何说明，成员分不清是应用坏了还是本来就空（#29678 的现场实测，#29769 只修了纯文档应用）。
- **风险与回滚**：只在原来什么都不落地的情况下生效；顶层导航有可落地条目的应用照旧落到原处。新空状态不带“去设置”按钮，也不说“无权限”，因为成员确实有权限。新增两条界面文案（十种语言）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` 的 `resolveLandingRoute` / `firstRouteAcross`（跨全部导航树的落地顺序）和 `AppRootLanding` 末尾（原来的 `return null`）；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppNoAccessEmptyState.tsx` 的 `menu-only` 分支。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.docOnlyLanding-29678.test.tsx`，应见 13 个用例全绿：只有分区的应用落到分区里的第一个对象，只有链接/动作的应用显示 `data-reason="menu-only"` 的空状态，原有对照组照旧。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Claim: issuecomment 6595973888, amended by 6596042756 (declaration lines `Clause-②: yes`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; surface plus `AppNoAccessEmptyState.tsx` and the ten locale packs).

An app whose entries live only under `areas`, or whose every entry is a `url` or `action` link, opened `/apps/APP` to an empty `main`. `resolveLandingRoute` walked only `shownTrees[0]` (the top-level `navigation`), although `AppRootLanding` already handed it every shown tree, and `AppRootLanding` then rendered `null`.

- **Landing walk across every shown tree** (`AppContent.tsx`, new `firstRouteAcross`). The declared landing first, then the first working entry (object, page, dashboard, report, component) across `navigation` and each `areas[].navigation` in order, then the first `doc` entry across the same order. The preference holds **across** the trees, not per tree: a working entry in any area outranks a `doc` entry in the top-level navigation. That is #29678's rule (a working entry outranks reading material) applied to the app rather than to one tree. The sidebar elects the area that holds the entry the route addresses (`electSidebarArea`), so a landing in a later area opens with that area active.
- **No in-app landing at all** (`AppContent.tsx`). When nothing lands and the app still shows the member entries, every one of them is a `url` or `action` link. The root now draws `AppNoAccessEmptyState` with a new `reason="menu-only"` instead of `null`.
- **`AppNoAccessEmptyState.tsx`**: the `menu-only` reason has its own title and description (`empty.appOpensFromMenu`, `empty.appOpensFromMenuDescription`), a menu icon instead of the lock, and no Setup link even when `setupPath` is given, because the member has access. The other two reasons are unchanged.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`**: the two keys in all ten locale packs.
- **`AppPreview.tsx`**: `findFirstLandingAcross` normalizes each area's navigation and walks the trees in the same order, so the designer names the entry the console opens on.
- **`appServesNoNavigation.ts`**: the docblock said the resolver walks the top-level navigation only and that a doc entry does not land; both went stale (#29678, and this PR). Docblock only.
- **Moved pin**: `AppContent.studioRootLanding-12113.test.tsx` pinned, for objectui#12113, that a url-only app "stays on its root, with no empty state and no page" (it asserted `app-no-access-empty-state` absent). This card makes exactly that blank root the defect, so the case now asserts the `menu-only` empty state; the "stays on its root, no page" half is kept. Seat-approved in the card thread.

## Tests

- `AppContent.docOnlyLanding-29678.test.tsx`, new top-level `describe` on the same harness (real `AppContent`, `ExpressionProvider`, `MePermissionsProvider`): an areas-only app lands on the first working entry of its areas; a working entry in an area outranks a top-level doc; a doc in an area lands when no tree holds a working entry; a url/action-only app (group and area included) draws `data-reason="menu-only"` with no Setup link; CONTROL: no shown navigation keeps `data-reason="no-navigation"`; CONTROL: a pending read in an area holds the skeleton, then lands. The file's #29678 cases (doc-only lands, object app redirects, no-navigation, pending read) stay as controls.
- `AppNoAccessEmptyState.sharedState-25915.test.tsx`: `menu-only` added to the `data-reason` table; its copy is not the no-access sentence; no Setup link with a setup path.
- `AppPreview.areas-11027.test.tsx`: the preview names the area entry for an areas-only app, prefers it over a top-level doc, and CONTROL keeps a top-level working entry first.
- `AppContent.studioRootLanding-12113.test.tsx`: the moved pin above.

## Acceptance notes

- **Across trees, not per tree** (seat ruling, card thread): a working entry anywhere outranks a doc anywhere. An app with a manual at the top of `navigation` and objects in an area opens on the first object.
- **The menu-only screen reuses `AppNoAccessEmptyState`** (seat ruling) and keeps its `data-testid="app-no-access-empty-state"`; `data-reason="menu-only"` is what tells it apart. It says nothing about access and offers no Setup link.
- **`Clause-②: yes`**: the two new keys widen `@object-ui/i18n`'s built `dist/locales/en.d.ts` (every leaf is a readonly literal and the entry re-exports `en` and `type TranslationKeys`). Changeset level stays `patch` with `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- Read from source (`UnifiedSidebar.tsx`), not measured, not changed: when an app has a visible area, `UnifiedSidebar` draws the active area's tree in place of the top-level `navigation` (`activeArea?.navigation || readableAppNavigation`). So in an app that has both, a landing on a top-level entry can open a page with no sidebar entry. This PR does not change that; the order here only decides which entry lands.
- Observed, not changed: on showcase the url-only app's root rewrote to its package address (`/apps/com.example.r29771-landing`), which is the existing package-address behaviour for the package's first app.

## Verification

Final head: `d1b4d8e8` (merge of `origin/main` at `b0ef25f5`).

<details><summary>Tests on the final head</summary>

On `d1b4d8e8`: every `console/__tests__/AppContent.*.test.tsx` file, `AppNoAccessEmptyState.sharedState-25915.test.tsx`, every `previews/AppPreview*.test.tsx` file and `packages/i18n/`: 150/150 files, 1932 passed, 13 skipped. `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --filter=@object-ui/i18n`: 66/66 tasks.

Before the main merge (head `fecc3403`): the four touched files 4/4, 33/33; the consumer sweep (every ui test file naming `AppContent`, `AppNoAccessEmptyState`, `AppPreview`, `appServesNoNavigation` or the empty-state keys) 155/155 files, 1305/1305 tests in four locked batches; `packages/i18n/` 95/95 files, 1443 passed, 13 skipped; `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --filter=@object-ui/i18n` 66/66 tasks; `eslint` on the touched ui files 0 errors.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each restored, blob equal to HEAD and git diff HEAD empty, by scripts/ablation-replace.mjs)</summary>

1. `resolveLandingRoute` walks `shownTrees.slice(0, 1)` only: `AppContent.docOnlyLanding-29678.test.tsx` 4 failed, 9 passed (the areas-only, area-over-doc, doc-in-area and pending-in-area cases).
2. The fallthrough back to `return null`: 2 failed across `docOnlyLanding-29678` and `studioRootLanding-12113` (both menu-only cases).
3. `AppPreview` walks `[navItems]` only: `AppPreview.areas-11027.test.tsx` 2 failed, 6 passed.
4. The `menu-only` branch made unreachable: `AppNoAccessEmptyState.sharedState-25915.test.tsx` 2 failed, 5 passed.
</details>

<details><summary>Local gate union</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 35 families on `fecc3403`; all 35 ran with exit 0 (`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 170 files passed, 2 skipped). `--ran` reconciliation: 35 derived, 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Also `node scripts/check-i18n-en-drift.mjs` (from `ui/`) exit 0: 2 keys added, 0 en values changed. The body gates (`check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-closing-keyword-parity`) ran against this body.
</details>

<details><summary>Live, showcase --fresh with the Console Vite on source</summary>

Four apps published into a scratch package `com.example.r29771-landing`: url-only (one `url` and one `action` entry), areas-only (`navigation: []`, first area holds an object entry for `showcase_account`, second a `url`), doc-only (a doc entry for `showcase_manual`), and an object app. Opened at `/apps/APP` as admin and as `auditor.demo@example.com`.

| app | before (AppContent.tsx at main) | after |
|:---|:---|:---|
| url-only | empty `main` (0 chars), admin and auditor | `data-reason="menu-only"`, "R29771 Links opens from its menu", admin and auditor |
| areas-only | empty `main` (0 chars), admin and auditor | redirects to `/apps/r29771_areas/showcase_account`, the list renders |
| doc-only (control) | | `/apps/r29771_doconly/docs/manual/showcase_index` |
| object app (control) | | `/apps/r29771_object/showcase_account` |

The before leg swapped only `AppContent.tsx` to main under Vite (Vite was confirmed serving main's module), then restored it (blob equal to HEAD). The after shots were taken before the swap. Shots: desktop for both personas plus a 390 px phone shot of the menu-only screen.
</details>
